selectionHistory: Chosen after first-generation observations, not a previously unobserved confirmatory hypothesis. Original 24 attempts remain unchanged. Owner-rich third repetition was still running at preparation; its two completed flat tool counts already force rejection under the fixed median criterion.
hypothesis: A generic filename-derived acronym sentence before the first Write reduces acronym-warning correction cycles without degrading artifact quality or increasing measured tool calls against the original baseline.

edit.anchor: STEP_2_FILL: immediately before Read the on-disk skeleton once
edit.sentence: Before the first Write, derive <ACR> for this spec’s own REQ/DL IDs from its filename stem (strip .spec.md, not SPEC_ID or directories): split on hyphens, discard empty parts, then uppercase each part’s initial if there are multiple parts, otherwise uppercase the first up to three characters.

sourceTruth: shared/sdd/requirement-id.ts: deriveSpecAcronym; canonical .spec.md filenames only for newly authored modules

decisionCriterion.adoptionReference: original baseline, not an easier post-hoc threshold
decisionCriterion.prompt: per-case nonincrease and at least one strict decrease against baseline
decisionCriterion.quality: no decrease of per-case artifact, semantic-pass or proven-path counts
decisionCriterion.tools: per-case sum, median and maximum must not increase

mechanismDiagnostic: Separately report first-Write requirement heading IDs, actual public SDD_REQ_ACRONYM_MISMATCH diagnostics and subsequent Writes. Canonical parent delegation is valid, with no invented local REQ IDs; it is not excluded from quality or tool metrics. Reflections are diagnostic hypotheses, not grading authority.

staticFootprint.scope: same six-part static instruction envelope, not provider context or tokenizer

nonRuntimeCarriedChanges: Six own completed template-rich journal entries are preserved from the reused worktree; they are not Gen2 observations. Plan and preregistration are metadata only. No CLI/runtime/oracle/policy/package changes.
semanticLimit: Original primary judges and path grades remain unchanged; this pilot does not claim independent full-flow review or turn inconclusive judgments into passes. Original 24-member supplemental population remains separate from these six new attempts.
